description.narrative:
The overall objecive of OECD's country programme for Ukraine is to support "the reconstruction and recovery of Ukraine in line with Ukraine's own priorities". The point of departure for the country programme, is Ukraine's official request for accession to the OECD and the OECD Council's recgnition of Ukraine as a prospective member. The country programme is a partnership "with a view to both Ukraine's recovery and its EU adn OECD accession ambition".
The expected outcomes for the four year country programme for Ukraine are as follows: - enhanced access to international best practice and exchange of experiences via greater participation in OECD bodies - tailor-made reviews and peer learning - improved quality of policy eforms in line with OECD standards - further anchoring of long-term reforms, including via adherence to selected OECD legal instruments - enhanced network of international experts and peers, and - stronger links with the OECD community. The OECD champion gender equality and has developed legal instruments to provide a framwork for policy action. Ukraine aims to adhere to these instruments and the programme includes capacity-building activitites to improve gender equality.
